title: Fixed High Arch and Central Moldboard Grader

No receiving hopper, cargo bed, bucket, trailing screed, glass or external source assets. One static prop, zero scenes; four opaque constant PBR roles, metres, Z up and full horizontal bounds-centred finite tyre sole datum. No hydraulic/engine internals, articulation, steering, wheel motion, blade adjustment, grading, material removal, traction, occupancy, loads, guarding, manufacture, machine operation, engineering/safety, rigging, animation or interaction verified. Static low-poly visual exterior only, not equipment guidance.
